family.description: This family of bacterial and lower eukaryote glycosyl hydrolases is related to CAZy family GH129,and distantly to GH101, and is made up of sub-families GHL1-GHL3. In the example [swissprot:C02A26], the substrate-binding Asp is residue 596, the nucleophilic Asp is residue 706, and the proton donor Glu is residue 747.
family.name: Glycosyl hydrolases related to GH101 family, GH129
